targets.notes: Write operations remain disabled. 0B-P1 qualified the deterministic YWD-1278 artifact hash. 0B-P2 physically requalified the 131072-byte main-flash geometry using two independent full reads through the YWD-1278 backup path; both reads were byte-identical and matched stock SHA256 4981b35b2d50ada0b09322d9de19dd58a0cbd49eb005693499d1acae92f9d684. GPIO20=BOOT0 and GPIO21=RESET were physically validated on the reference Pi 5/HAT. Normal application release is BOOT0 low and RESET high without a pulse; explicit bootloader entry uses BOOT0 high plus one RESET low/high pulse; returning from the system bootloader uses BOOT0 low plus one RESET low/high pulse. Option-byte operations are forbidden. Flash remains disabled until the guarded YWD-1278 write plus exact stock restore round trip is qualified.
